title: Blender core editable character asset pipeline
objective: Promote Blender from rigging-only fallback to the core editable 3D DCC/master-asset stage for KHOSAN characters, document the Spawn-inspired workflow without claiming proprietary internals, and add a safe headless Blender adapter contract that ChatGPT can drive through DevSpace.
acceptance_criteria: Blender is registered as a core Asset Synthesizer tool for editable 3D master assets rather than only a rigging fallback.
The architecture keeps Asset IR and UG-IR canonical above Blender-specific representation.
Editable .blend master assets and runtime .glb artifacts have distinct roles and paths.
A versioned JSON character-edit contract exists for allowlisted semantic operations and does not permit arbitrary Python execution.
A headless adapter can validate a job, invoke Blender background mode, apply supported semantic edits, save the .blend master, and export GLB.
Documentation separates publicly verified Spawn capabilities from KHOSAN design inference and does not claim knowledge of proprietary Spawn internals.
Local DevSpace verification includes harness check, adapter unit tests, Blender doctor, and at least one real GLB or BLEND round-trip before acceptance.
verification: Run a real local Blender fixture round-trip and inspect the produced .blend and .glb before changing this task to accepted.
human_gates: Human owner explicitly approved Blender as a core KHOSAN Asset Lab direction and requested the documentation/code be persisted to the project GitHub on 2026-09-29.
dependencies: SkinTokens/UniRig evaluation remains separate for automatic rig generation
risks: Blender Python API compatibility varies by version; supported versions remain provisional until local fixture evidence exists.
Semantic morph edits require existing shape keys or a separate modeling/sculpt generation path.
Corrective muscle deformation and secondary motion require authored rig/morph/driver data; this adapter must not pretend those capabilities exist on arbitrary meshes.
No local DevSpace/Blender execution evidence has been recorded in this branch yet.
notes: Implementation scaffold is present, but task remains in verify until traceable local execution and maker/checker separation are completed.
